scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof of strict partial-matching case; no priority claims for first definitions, perfect-matching crown graphs, or the complete-bipartite case. Finite exhaustive tests independently implement the original coloring definition; they corroborate but do not prove the infinite result. No independent mathematical assessment performed.
scientific_limitations: Only p,q>=2 and 1<=t<min(p,q); not arbitrary edge deletions or full deletion of a matching saturating one side. Equivalent unindexed literature is a residual priority risk.
title: Strong odd coloring polynomial of bicliques with a partially deleted matching
